detached_structure.evidence: A smaller roofed building with a gray roof sits northwest of the center house at the top of the driveway, possibly a separate house or outbuilding, and small sheds may be near it.

signals.notes: The center house has a multi-gable gray shingle roof with some dark staining and a sunken dark patch. Mature trees lie on the west side, and a paved drive curves along the north edge; the vehicles shown are on the road or drive, not clearly parked at this house.
